name: Lexis
author: Fatih Aydost
description: Ambient vocabulary habit plugin for Omarchy with non-intrusive corner question cards, spaced repetition, word list import from CSV, PDF, DOCX, ODT and TXT, hybrid Free Dictionary lookup, and optional CLI or local AI support.

barWidget.description: Ambient vocabulary flashcards, quick word capture, and today's progress in the popout.
